description: Defines the BuzzLikeOnComment entity class for ORM, representing a 'like' on a comment in the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, including properties for comment, employee, and timestamp, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnComment
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' on a comment in the Buzz plugin, with ORM mappings and methods to access and modify its properties.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the like.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who liked the comment.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who liked the comment.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the like was made in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the likedAtUtc property to the current UTC time.
